verses.text: T'a stzolal tz'aj yilan yopisio heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Aarón chi'. Axo heb' winh yuninal winh: Haton winhaj Nadab, winhaj Abiú, winhaj Eleazar yet' winhaj Itamar.

Ha winhaj Nadab yet' winhaj Abiú chi', b'ab'laj chamnak heb' winh t'a yichanh winh smam chi'. Mantalaj yuninal heb' winh schamnak heb' winh chi', yuj chi' anhej winhaj Eleazar yet' winhaj Itamar ix och sakerdoteal.
Makkiltak ix aj heb' winh sakerdote yuj winhaj rey David chi', yuj winhaj Sadoc yinhtilal winhaj Eleazar yet' winhaj Ahimelec yinhtilal winhaj Itamar.

Axo ix yilan heb' winh to a heb' winh yinhtilalkan winhaj Eleazar chi' tzijtum sb'isul heb' winh t'a yichanh heb' winh yinhtilalkan winhaj Itamar, yuj chi' 16 makan ix aj heb' winh, haxo heb' winh yinhtilalkan winhaj Itamar chi', wajxak makannhej heb' winh.

T'a sorteoal ix aj yochkan junjun makan heb' winh t'a stzolal smunlaji, yujto ha t'a skal heb' winh yinhtilalkan winhaj Eleazar yet' t'a skal heb' winh yinhtilalkan winhaj Itamar ay heb' winh niwak yajal sik'b'iloch t'a yopisio t'a templo t'a yichanh Dios.

Ha heb' winh yajal yaj t'a skal heb' winh yinhtilalkan winhaj Eleazar yet' pax heb' winh yinhtilalkan winhaj Itamar, ix sik' sorteo heb' winh t'a stzolal, jun yik heb' winh yinhtilalkan winhaj Eleazar chi', jun pax yik heb' winh yinhtilalkan winhaj Itamar chi'. Icha chi' ix aj smunlaj heb' winh t'a yopisio. Axo winhaj Semaías yuninal winhaj Natanael yinhtilalkan winhaj Leví ix tz'ib'an sb'i heb' winh ayik ix sik'an sorteo chi' heb' winh. Axo heb' winh sakerdote ayoch t'a yopisio yet' winh rey, haton winhaj Sadoc yet' winhaj Ahimelec yuninal winhaj Abiatar yet' heb' winh yajal yaj t'a skal heb' winh sakerdote chi' yet' t'a skal heb' winh lewita, testigo yajkan heb' winh.

Haton sb'i heb' winh tik ix kannhej t'a junjun makan t'a stzolal, icha syal sb'i heb' winh yajalil heb' winh ix sik'an sorteo chi', schael yich t'a heb' winh b'ab'el masanto t'a heb' winh slajwub', 24 makan heb' winh t'a smasanil: Winhaj Joiarib, winhaj Jedaías, winhaj Harim, winhaj Seorim, winhaj Malquías, winhaj Mijamín, winhaj Cos, winhaj Abías, winhaj Jesúa, winhaj Secanías, winhaj Eliasib, winhaj Jakim, winhaj Hupa, winhaj Jesebeab, winhaj Bilga, winhaj Imer, winhaj Hezir, winhaj Afses, winhaj Petaías, winhaj Hezekiel, winhaj Jaquín, winhaj Gamul, winhaj Delaía yet' winhaj Maazías.

Haton heb' winh tik ix pojchajek' t'a stzolal t'a sakerdoteal yik smunlaj heb' winh t'a templo, icha syal sley Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, icha ajnak yalan t'a winhaj Aarón smam yicham heb' winh.
Haton sb'i heb' winh yajal yaj t'a skal juntzanhxo heb' winh yinhtilal Leví tik: Haton winhaj Jehedías yinhtilal winhaj Subael, yinhtilal pax winhaj Amram.
Winhaj Isías b'ab'el t'a skal heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Rehabías.
Winhaj Jahat yinhtilal winhaj Selomot, yinhtilal pax winhaj Izhar.
Ha heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Hebrón t'a stzolal: Haton winhaj Jerías, winhaj Amarías, winhaj Jahaziel yet' winhaj Jekamán.
Winhaj Samir yinhtilal winhaj Micaía, yinhtilal pax winhaj Uziel.
Winhaj Zacarías yuninal winhaj Isías yuk'tak winhaj Micaía.
Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Merari: Haton winhaj Mahli, winhaj Musi yet' winhaj Jaazías.
Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jaazías chi': Haton winhaj Beno, winhaj Soham, winhaj Zacur yet' winhaj Ibri.
Chawanh yuninal winhaj Mahli chi': Haton winhaj Eleazar yet' winhaj Cis. Ha winhaj Eleazar chi', malaj yuninal winh. Axo pax winhaj Cis chi', ay jun yuninal winh, haton winhaj Jerameel.
Axo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Musi chi': Haton winhaj Mahli, winhaj Edar yet' winhaj Jerimot. Haton heb' winh chi' yajal yaj t'a skal heb' yinhtilal Leví.

Anhejtona' heb' winh chi', t'a sorteoal ix aj yoch heb' winh t'a stzolal smunlaji, icha ix sk'ulej heb' winh sk'ab'yok heb' winh, haton heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Aarón. Haton t'a yichanh winhaj rey David yet' winhaj Sadoc yet' winhaj Ahimelec yet' heb' winh yajal yaj t'a skal heb' yinhtilal Leví yet' heb' winh sakerdote, ata' ix och sorteo chi'. Lajannhej ix aj heb' winh yajal yaj t'a skal yinhtilal winh b'ab'el winak yet' t'a skal yinhtilal winh tzak'anto.
